rationale.ai-review: Proposes a multi-agent framework to autonomously review pull requests.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Runtime Analysis Agent executes PR code in a sandbox for deterministic checks.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Defines explicit human-in-the-loop quality gates and mandatory approval checkpoints.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Features explanation agents and visual diff-maps to aid human comprehension.
rationale.framework: Contributes a reference architecture integrating AI agents into build pipelines.
rationale.design-only: Specifies the agent architecture in buildable detail without running it.
rationale.agentic: Assesses oversight of AI-accelerated code delivered at pull request granularity.
rationale.risk-security: Substantive treatment of the harm via focal analysis of injected vulnerabilities.
rationale.risk-quality: Substantive treatment of the harm by analyzing defect and regression detection.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Substantive treatment of the harm via a focal section on automation bias.
